tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the MCP Rating index of MCP servers. Returns matches for a query, optionally filtered by category and sorted by quality, stars, downloads, recency, or name, each marked with the outcome of our own start test when we have run one, and with its last release and last code push dates where we kno

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get what is known about one MCP server by slug: whether it started when we ran it ourselves (no credentials, on a schedule), how it is maintained (last release, last code push, open issues, archived or deprecated), how to run it (install command or hosted endpoint), the keys it declares, its tools w

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available MCP server categories with the count of servers in each.

tools.name: get_index_stats
tools.description: Get overall statistics about the MCP Rating index: total servers, top categories, and last crawl time.

tools.name: get_install_config
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-paste configuration snippet for connecting a discovered MCP server to Claude Desktop or Cursor. MCP servers cannot auto-install — users must manually add configuration. This tool reduces that friction.

tools.name: discover_server
tools.description: Fetch the live .well-known/mcp discovery manifest from an indexed MCP server. Returns transport endpoints, capabilities, and auth requirements needed to connect. Only works for servers that support MCP discovery.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_server" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
